editorial_intent: Diagram how chronic physical overtraining locks hippocampal tyrosine hydroxylase activity and dopamine synthesis into hyperarousal 48 hours post-exertion.
subject: A split-section schematic of hippocampal pyramidal neurons showing sustained L-DOPA enzymatic conversion by tyrosine hydroxylase, overflowing synaptic vesicles with dopamine molecules (burnt saffron ochre), while serotonin pathways (muted mineral sage) remain static and baseline.
setting: Framed by a geometric cranial meridian dome, a 24-division circadian astrolabe calibration arc, and a phase-coherent geodesic neural constellation rendered in deep midnight slate linework.
composition: Asymmetric Post-Constructivist dual-panel lithograph layout: the left panel shows acute post-exercise baseline clearance; the right panel shows the 48-hour overtraining failure of enzymatic feedback dampening via heavy terracotta vectors and dense saffron dot-matrix concentrations.
